_meta.indication: FOTIVDA is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory advanced renal cell carcinoma (RCC) following two or more prior systemic therapies.

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, open-label, controlled trial; 350 patients randomized 1:1 to tivozanib 1.34 mg once daily for 21 consecutive days followed by 7 days off vs. sorafenib 400 mg twice daily; stratified by IMDC risk category and prior therapy.
pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients with relapsed or refractory advanced RCC who received 2 or 3 prior systemic treatments (2 TKIs, a TKI plus a checkpoint inhibitor, or a TKI plus other agent), ECOG PS ≤1.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Progression-free survival (PFS) in all randomized patients per Blinded Independent Review Committee (BIRC) assessment.
pivotal_trials.result: PFS HR 0.73 (95% CI 0.56 to 0.95), p=0.016; median PFS 5.59 months (tivozanib) vs. 3.88 months (sorafenib). ORR 18% vs. 8%. Final OS HR 0.97 (95% CI 0.75 to 1.24); median OS 16.39 vs. 19.15 months.

key_safety: Most common (≥20%) adverse reactions: fatigue, hypertension, diarrhea, decreased appetite, nausea, dysphonia, hypothyroidism, cough, and stomatitis. Serious adverse reactions occurred in 45% of FOTIVDA patients; fatal adverse reactions in 8% (including pneumonia 1.7%). Hypertension occurred in 45% (22% ≥Grade 3). Hemorrhagic events in 11%.
target_moa: Tivozanib is a kinase inhibitor that inhibits phosphorylation of VEGFR-1, VEGFR-2 and VEGFR-3, and also inhibits other kinases including c-kit and PDGFRβ at clinically relevant concentrations.

advisory_committee.vote: No ODAC was convened for this application (NDA 212904). (A prior ODAC on May 2, 2013 for the earlier tivozanib NDA based on TIVO-1 voted 13:1 "No.")

summary.text: NDA 212904 for tivozanib was submitted and received March 31, 2020 under standard review, with a PDUFA goal date of March 31, 2021, and received regular (not accelerated) approval based on the PFS benefit in the pivotal Phase 3 TIVO-3 trial. No advisory committee was convened for this application and there were no postmarketing requirements or commitments.

citations.quote: Please refer to your new drug application (NDA) dated and received March 31, 2020, and your amendments, submitted under section 505(b) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (FDCA) for Fotivda (tivozanib) 0.89 mg and 1.34 mg capsules.
All disciplines were in favor of a regular approval. There are no postmarketing requirements or postmarketing commitments for this application.
No ODAC was convened for this application.

date.text: A prior CR letter was issued June 6, 2013 for tivozanib based on review of TIVO-1 (the earlier NDA), not for this application (NDA 212904).

citations.quote: Despite the negative previous ODAC vote for tivozanib and the subsequent CR letter issued on June 6, 2013 for tivozanib based on review of TIVO-1, the review team felt that the totality of the TIVO-3 data warranted an approval in this case given the PFS advantage, supportive ORR, detailed safety analysis, and the HR for OS that ultimately did not demonstrate a decrement in patients who were requir

basis.text: The prior CR letter (June 6, 2013) was based on review of TIVO-1, which showed a trend towards a detrimental effect on overall survival with tivozanib in treatment-naïve advanced RCC.

citations.quote: Although TIVO-1 met its primary endpoint (PFS HR = 0.80 [95% CI: 0.64, 0.99], p = 0.04), a trend towards a detrimental effect on survival was observed with tivozanib (OS HR = 1.25 [95% CI: 0.95, 1.62], p = 0.11).
